name: Gypsy Q
source:
A mysterious woman with a large build who appears before Teru's group.

A hispanic beauty of indeterminate age who is covered from head to toe in motorcycle clothing and who rides a large motorcycle.

[Translated from [url=http://clockup.net/dd/character.html]the offical site[/url]]
